evolution.title: Evolution
evolution.description: Variants, live canary traffic, and guarded promotion. A 0% canary stays in shadow.
evolution.noCanary: No canary configured. Start one from the actions above; state is written to variants/state.json.
evolution.noCanaryNote: Runs are bucketed by runId: the configured percent uses the candidate, the rest stay on the live pack. Evaluation and rollback are separate actions.
evolution.noVariantsDesc: Create a baseline and a candidate from the CLI, then score them. Example:
evolution.note: Scores come from variants/archive.jsonl; only agent files may change. Locked-file hash mismatches cause scoring to fail before any evaluation runs.
evolution.explainerBody: The team reviews its own failures, rewrites one role's instructions, tests the candidate against the same evidence, and keeps the result only if it beats the champion. You see every proposal, score, diff, and rollback. Promotion stays a separate, reversible step unless you explicitly allow automatic promotion.
evolution.stepSignalsBody: Failed gates, low scores, overrides, and cost anomalies become the hypothesis.
evolution.stepProposeBody: A meta-agent rewrites one agent file. Tools and permissions are frozen.
evolution.stepEvaluateBody: Champion and candidate run on the same evidence with an independent judge.
evolution.stepPromoteBody: Only improvements enter the archive. Canary sends real traffic to the candidate, compares pass rate, score, and cost, and rolls back automatically on regression.
evolution.explainerSafety: Evaluators and locked files are outside the writable surface; every promotion has a backup and a rollback path.
evolution.noCycles: No cycles yet. Run one to create a proposal, scores, and an archive record.
evolution.goodhartBody: Process scores are not results. Evolution pauses when scores rise while acceptance or human review stays flat or falls, and the champion is re-scored in full when the input distribution, evaluator agreement or the provider pin changes.
evolution.goodhartNote: Outcomes come from kit evolve outcome record (artifact acceptance or human review). The file is an adapter; the durable reason lives on the cycle and the freeze state.
evolution.divergenceNone: No reviewed cycle shows score up with outcome flat or worse yet.
evolution.driftNone: No drift findings in the latest cycle.
evolution.governanceNone: No divergence or drift events recorded.
evolution.attributionBody: Compares the live pass, apply, cost, risk and incident windows produced by a change with the champion window (kit evolve attribute). A change whose offline score rose while live results fell pauses evolution and is reverted through the unified change revertRef.
evolution.attributionEmpty: No attribution records yet. Record one with kit evolve attribute <changeId> --offline-delta <n>.
evolution.attributionWindow: champion {baselineTasks} tasks · pass {baselinePass}% → change {changedTasks} tasks · pass {changedPass}% · cost {cost}
evolution.attributionNote: Records are written by kit evolve attribute; the rollback itself is the change proposal's audited rollback transition.

evolutionActions.startDesc: 0% starts in shadow; above 0 routes that share of new runs to the candidate.
evolutionActions.trafficDesc: Changes the share of new runs routed to the candidate. 0% returns to shadow.
evolutionActions.evaluateDesc: Champion and candidate are scored on the same frozen eval snapshot. Every score and the resulting decision are persisted.
evolutionActions.rollbackDesc: Marks the current canary as rolled back. State is persisted.
evolutionActions.promoteDesc: Dry run by default. Applying copies only agent files and creates a backup first.
evolutionActions.evidenceOptionalHint: Leave empty to auto-generate evidence from recent failed iterations and signals. When present, this JSON overrides the generated set.
evolutionActions.architectureHint: Architecture promotions need operator, security and architecture approvals, a non-LIVE validation and the same workspace. Request the approvals, then decide them in the approvals inbox.
